headline: Silver and Gold Fall to Multi-Month Lows on Crude-Driven Inflation and Rate Fears
summary: Silver prices plummeted to an 11-month low and gold dropped significantly as high crude oil prices intensified inflation concerns, driving expectations of prolonged high interest rates.
why: Precious metals trade inversely to rising real yields and opportunity costs generated by expectations of tighter global monetary policy.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Expectations that central banks will maintain higher interest rates to fight oil-driven inflation reduce the appeal of non-yielding assets.

why_moved: Precious metals retreated sharply as rising crude oil prices fueled inflation worries and spurred investors to price in higher interest rates.
